Interface PluginSettings

public interface PluginSettings
Plugin settings (hierarchical key-value store).

It is implemented by emuStudio. Plugins obtain this object in the constructor. Getters return empty Optional if the key is missing or the value has a different type. Use orElse(default) for default values. Keys are case-sensitive.

Keys must not start with EMUSTUDIO_PREFIX. This prefix is reserved for emuStudio settings, some of which are readable by plugins.
